"""Luhn algorithm validation for card numbers."""


def valid(number: str) -> bool:
    """Return whether ``number`` passes the Luhn check.

    ``number`` is a string of digits; spaces are ignored. It is invalid if,
    after removing spaces, it has fewer than two characters or contains any
    character other than the digits ``0``-``9``.
    """
    digits = number.replace(" ", "")
    if len(digits) < 2 or not all("0" <= char <= "9" for char in digits):
        return False

    total = 0
    for position, char in enumerate(reversed(digits)):
        digit = ord(char) - ord("0")
        if position % 2 == 1:
            digit *= 2
            if digit > 9:
                digit -= 9
        total += digit

    return total % 10 == 0
